contract_documents.document_text: The parties use purchase orders to specify quantities, prices, and delivery dates. An order becomes binding when the supplier confirms it in writing. The supplier must deliver the quantities and by the dates stated in a confirmed order.

provisions.clause_text: A purchase order becomes binding when the supplier confirms acceptance in writing. The confirmed purchase order specifies the applicable quantity, unit price, and delivery date.
The supplier shall deliver the quantity stated in each confirmed purchase order by the delivery date stated in that order.

contract_documents.document_text: Buyer orders 240 control modules, item CM-8, at $42 per unit. Requested delivery date: September 30. The order is subject to the Framework Supply Agreement FA-26.

provisions.clause_text: Item CM-8: quantity 240; unit price $42; delivery due September 30. This order is subject to Framework Supply Agreement FA-26.

contract_documents.document_text: The supplier confirms acceptance of Purchase Order PO-418 without changes. The confirmed line, price, and delivery date match the purchase order.

provisions.clause_text: We accept Purchase Order PO-418 without changes: 240 units of item CM-8 at $42 per unit, delivery due September 30.

assessment_rationale: The agreement makes written supplier confirmation the condition for a binding order and assigns order-specific terms to the confirmed purchase order. The purchase order states all three claimed terms, and the sales order confirmation accepts it without changes. Read together, the documents support the delivery obligation, quantity, price, and deadline.
